questions.question: [Q] THE QUOTING RULE (data/b754_agenda.txt :313; data/b754_ferry.txt :36). CURRENT: N5 as (R363) wrote it; the citation check printing cited lines of PLACE-papers' ledgers into pushed banks (data/b753_defects.txt (h')); b753's waiver by class (data/b753_events.txt (5)), which reaches this act's agenda and no further. DRAFTED, four rows of data/b754_rules.txt: (1) a relay bank may quote a line of PLACE-papers' ledgers and front door, with its path and line, where a check, a read or an item's CURRENT needs the words; (2) a paper's released edition is public text, and an edition not yet released is quoted where a sitting's CURRENT or DRAFTED carries it and otherwise cited by path, line and the opening sixteen characters of its sha256; (3) the exception by place and not by word: REGISTRY's section headed at :373, every ledger line carrying that heading's leading word with two lines either side, OPEN_TRAILS' O.7 whole and FINDINGS :820-:826, cited by path, line and digest and not quoted until your own review of that class, the word read at run time and held in no tracked file; (4) the other seven private repositories: names, sizes, dates and hashes. With it THE ORIGIN SEARCH, tools/standing/originsearch.py, built from tools/b753_waiver_inv0.py to _inv9.py, its three controls in its bank and its reach in its head (a run of words and a figure or formula as written; no paraphrase, no other notation). Passed: the rows read by N5 from b755 on, and the tool landed with VERSION moved before the gate, the seat's price 0.6 to 1.2 h. Struck: the waiver's class stands for this act alone and the question returns at the next sitting. How does [Q] go?
